content.comment_body: Hello, When I try to download my program to the [product_name] device, nothing happens. I connect the [product_name] and my PC as usual, and this part works fine. However, when I attempt to download the program, the typical 'Set to run' popup does not appear. What could be causing this issue? I'm using a USB-C to Ethernet adapter since my laptop doesn't have a built-in Ethernet port. Any suggestions would be appreciated! - [user_name]

Have you checked if the connection is working by performing a communication check? If there is no error message, it's possible there's an issue within the program itself, which might prevent it from being downloaded, even though testing may still be possible.
Hi, Are you using multiple monitors on your PC? If so, check if the popup dialog is being displayed on another screen.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encounters an issue where the expected confirmation popup ('Set to run') does not appear when trying to download a program from their PC to a [product_name] device. The physical connection, facilitated by a USB-C to Ethernet adapter, seems to work, but the program download is halted either due to a program error or the popup being rendered on a different monitor in a multi-display setup. No error messages are provided, making it difficult for users to complete this essential workflow step.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates a smooth download process, including all necessary confirmation popups, in order to successfully transfer and execute their program on the [product_name] device.
